facts.business: Hexagon Nutrition Limited is an integrated nutrition company providing micronutrient premixes, clinical nutrition, therapeutic foods, food fortification, and consumer nutrition solutions across domestic and international markets.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter on: (a) conversion of CCPS into equity shares subsequent to reporting date (Note 52/53); (b) listing of equity shares on stock exchange subsequent to reporting date (Note 53/54); (c) merger of Hexagon Nutrition (Exports) Private Limited with Hexagon Nutrition Limited (Note 54 Consolidated).

key_risks: Inventory valuation risk due to significant management judgment on net realizable value, future demand, obsolescence, and selling prices
Capital expenditure classification risk involving judgment on capitalization vs expense, useful lives, depreciation rates, and impairment indicators
Contingent liabilities risk from significant judgments and management estimates on pending litigations, guarantees, claims, and tax matters
